description: Create reusable dashboard UI components and hooks for data fetching. Components: MetricCard (voltage/current/power/energy display), HeroEnergyCard (main energy display), LoadingCard (skeleton), ErrorCard (retry UI). Hooks: useDashboardData (fetches getDashboardMetrics), useRecentReading (fetches getRecentReadings with limit 1). These components and hooks will be shared by both public and admin dashboard screens.
steps: Create mobile/src/components/dashboard/MetricCard.tsx - displays single metric (label, value, unit) with loading/error/null states. Props: label: string, value: number | null | undefined, unit: string, precision?: number, color?: 'green' | 'blue' | 'amber'. Style: white card with shadow, 16px padding, rounded 12px. Value display: large bold number (32px), unit in gray (16px). Handle null distinctly from 0 - show '--' for null, '0' for zero. Show skeleton for loading. Design matches EcoStep visual identity with #2FBF71 accent color.

Create mobile/src/components/dashboard/HeroEnergyCard.tsx - hero card for daily energy. Props: energyValue: number | null | undefined, aiInsight?: string, isLoading: boolean, isError: boolean, onRetry: () => void. Style: larger card (approx 2x height of MetricCard), white bg, 20px padding, rounded 12px. Display: 'Daily Energy' title, energy value in large font (48px bold) with 'kWh' unit, AI insight in smaller italic text if available. Loading shows skeleton. Error shows message + retry button. Null shows '--' distinctly from zero.

Create mobile/src/components/dashboard/LoadingCard.tsx - skeleton loading state for cards. Animated placeholder with gray background pulses. Matches card styling (white bg, rounded, shadow). Used when data is loading initially.

Create mobile/src/components/dashboard/ErrorCard.tsx - error display with retry button. Props: message: string, onRetry: () => void. Style: card with red border, error icon, error message, 'Retry' button. Matches overall card styling.
Create mobile/src/components/dashboard/index.ts - barrel export for all dashboard components

Create mobile/src/hooks/useDashboardData.ts - custom hook wrapping getDashboardMetrics() from dashboard.service. Returns: { data: DashboardMetrics | null, isLoading: boolean, isError: boolean, error: Error | null, refetch: () => Promise<void> }. Uses useState and useEffect. Initial load on mount. Does not poll - single fetch only (real-time is Stage 4). Handles errors gracefully. Uses useCallback for refetch function.

Create mobile/src/hooks/useRecentReading.ts - custom hook wrapping getRecentReadings(1) from energy.service. Returns: { reading: EnergyReading | null, isLoading: boolean, isError: boolean, error: Error | null, refetch: () => Promise<void> }. Initial load on mount. Does not poll. Extracts first reading from array or returns null if empty.
Create mobile/src/hooks/index.ts - barrel export for hooks

useDashboardData hook calls getDashboardMetrics() and returns proper loading/error/data states
useRecentReading hook calls getRecentReadings(1) and extracts single reading or null

verification: Run 'cd mobile && npm run type-check' and confirm 0 TypeScript errors
Verify all component files exist and export default React components
Verify all hook files exist and export custom hooks with proper return types
Check that imports from Stage 2 types (DashboardMetrics, EnergyReading) and services (getDashboardMetrics, getRecentReadings) resolve correctly
